title: The Adventure of Helga
description: Play as Helga, a lost soul facing dangerous trials beyond death. Pass through three mysterious gates and uncover the truth behind this strange world.
body:

After her death, Helga awakens in a strange and unfamiliar world. It is neither heaven nor hell — a place shaped by fears, memories, and choices. To move forward, Helga must pass through three Gates, each one testing not strength, but the soul.

Along the way, players will encounter:

• unique challenges and puzzles 🧩

• a dark and immersive atmosphere ✨

• a story that unfolds gradually 📖

• meaningful choices that shape the experience ⭐

This map is more than just an adventure. It is a journey within, where every step matters.

Are you ready to discover what lies beyond life? 🤔
